entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely the wrong size and this whole process is ridiculous.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your order. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference with the fit?

A preference? Are you kidding me? It's way too tight! I can barely get it on. It's obviously the wrong size. I want to exchange this thing or get my money back, and I want to do it now. This is unacceptable.
I understand your frustration, and I'm sure we can get this sorted out. Could I please have your name and order number to pull up the details?
The name is Sam Jones, order number 778-V-9012. You'd better fix this, or I'm lighting you up on every review site I can find. I want to speak to your manager.

I'm confident I can resolve this for you without an escalation, Mr. Jones. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see the purchase for the Aero Performance jersey. I just need to check our return policy for that item.
There's nothing to check. Just process the return. It's a simple exchange.
Okay, I've got it here. It looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely get this processed for you immediately.
I can either process a full refund to your original payment method, or I can set up an exchange for the next size up. Which would you prefer?
Fine. Do the exchange. I just want a jersey that fits.

Excellent. I have just processed the exchange order for you. I am also sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. You can use that to send back the jersey that's too tight. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. Just make sure it actually works this time.
It will. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
